title: Delta Electronics InfraSuite Device Master APRunning Improper Access Control Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Delta Electronics InfraSuite Device Master. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the gateway endpoint, which listens on TCP ports 80 and 443 by default. The issue results from improper access control. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise.
